title: Uploading evidence to an open CAR still auto-flips status to remediation_in_progress after deploy
preconditions: A CAR exists with status='open' and no evidence attached
steps: Attach a valid evidence file to the CAR via addEvidence
expectedResult: The CAR's status shows 'remediation_in_progress' immediately after the first evidence attachment, consistent with pre-deploy behavior.

title: Closure request-approval is blocked until every checklist item is marked complete
preconditions: An audit closure checklist has at least one incomplete item
expectedResult: The request is rejected — requestApproval() (audit-closure.service.js:87-129) requires closure.checklist to be 100% completed before allowing a request to proceed.

title: Creating a management review with attendees and agenda persists and appears in the review list
steps: Create a new management review with 2 attendees and a 3-item agenda
Navigate back to the management reviews list for the audit
expectedResult: The new review appears in the list with status='planned', correct attendee count, and agenda items intact.

title: Global findings search endpoint returns results without error for an organization with a large finding volume
preconditions: Org has 500+ findings across multiple audits
steps: Call GET /api/audit-assurance/findings/search with a common search term
expectedResult: The endpoint returns within an acceptable response time, capped at 20 results per page, with no timeout or 500 error.
